results.title: Jhoom Barabar Jhoom
results.overview: London, an overcrowded cafe, one table to share. Two strangers tell each other “how I met my fiancé” stories to kill time. Rikki met his fiance Anaida at the Ritz in Paris and Alvira met her prince charming Steve at Madame Tussauds

results.title: Bawaal
results.overview: Ajay Dixit, an ordinary history teacher in a high school, enjoys mini celebrityhood in his town courtesy of the fake image he has built. He shares a strained relationship with his newly-wed wife. Circumstances force him to take a trip to Europe for the World War II trail accompanied by his wife. Will his relationship with his wife survive this trip? Will he manage to win the war within?

results.title: Bullett Raja
results.overview: A common man who transforms into a gangster revolts against the very system he once obediently followed by declaring war on the police, the government, and the industrialists.

results.title: Trimurti
results.overview: Entrapped by notorious gangster Khokha Singh, honest police inspector Satyadevi Singh gets a life sentence in jail. She hopes to get her three sons Shakti, Anand and Romi to avenge this carnage.

results.title: Race 2
results.overview: Ranvir Singh encounters the Indian mafia in Turkey as he carries out a mission to avenge his lover's death.

results.title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
results.overview: A man comes to America in order to find his brother who is wanted by the police. But his search forces him to get mixed up with a lady gangster that facilitates illegal underground fights.

results.title: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
results.original_title: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
results.overview: Inpired from the movie "Liar Liar", this movie is about a lawyer (Govinda) who lies his way through marriage and career. His wife (Sushmita Sen) falls in love with him because of his honesty and when she finds out of his dishonesty she threatens to divorce him. Their son, to avoid the divorce, wishes on a shooting star that his father should lose the ability to lie. What happens after that is an enjoyable journey.

results.title: Choked: Paisa Bolta Hai
results.overview: A bank employee weighed down by her jobless husband's debts - and her own broken dreams - finds a secret source of seemingly unlimited cash in her home.

results.title: Dor
results.overview: Two woman, from different backgrounds and living miles apart, are linked by tragedy. Their new-found friendship is tested as one holds the fate of the other's husband in her hands.

results.title: Eklavya: The Royal Guard
results.overview: As the kingdom of Devigarh comes apart at the seams, an aging bodyguard attempts to protect the Royal Family, as well as keep its darkest secrets from ever coming to light.

results.title: Aan: Men at Work
results.overview: Crime is at its highest peak in Mumbai with it split in three ways. Walia has one-third, Manik Rao has one-third and Roshni has a third of the Mumbai territory. The crime rate rises with more smuggling, trading and illegal activities soaring.

results.title: Milestone
results.overview: As soon as veteran driver Ghalib’s truck touches the 500,000 kilometers mark - a record at his company - he is struck by a sudden pain in his back. As Ghalib struggles with this ache, an existential threat begins to overwhelm him when he is asked to train a young new driver.

results.title: Jolly LLB 2
results.overview: A blunt, abrasive and yet oddly compassionate Jagdishwar Mishra aka Jolly, a small-time struggling lawyer who moves from Kanpur to the city of Nawabs to pursue his dream of becoming a big-time lawyer.

results.title: Kisi Ka Bhai... Kisi Ki Jaan
results.original_title: किसी का भाई... किसी की जान
results.overview: Bhaijaan, a self-defense trainer lives happily as a bachelor with his three brothers Moh, Ishq and Luv and uses violence to settle disputes. When his brothers, who’ve already found partners, come together to fix a match for him, Bhagya Lakshmi, Bhaijaan decides to mend his ways for his lover's sake. All hell breaks loose when he learns about Bhagya's family facing threats from their haunting past.

results.title: Raaz
results.overview: A couple goes for a vacation to the scenic mountains of Ooty to save their crumbling marriage, but the bungalow they are staying at is haunted by a vengeful spirit that holds a secret.

results.title: Newton
results.overview: A government clerk on election duty in a conflict-ridden jungle of Central India tries his best to conduct free and fair voting despite the apathy of security forces and the looming fear of guerrilla attacks by communist rebels.

results.title: Hate Story 3
results.overview: Siya appears to be the bone of contention between warring businessmen Aditya and Saurav. But this one runs deeper than your average love triangle.

results.title: Pyaar Kiya To Darna Kya
results.overview: A wealthy collegian falls in love with an heir apparent, but her domineering cousin orders her to end the affair.

results.title: Hungama
results.overview: A case of mistaken identities featuring a young woman, an electronics business owner and an aspiring musician which leads to chaotic yet hilarious situations.

results.title: Rangoon
results.overview: Julia travels to the Indo-Burma border to perform for the troops during the World War II, on the insistence of Billimoria, her lover. She finds herself in love with Jemadar Malik, a soldier there.
